lines.en: I hop about along the branches
My red feathers shine in the light
I flutter across to another branch
I look down for seeds on the ground
I land on the ground and hop twice
My crest stands up
I hop and tilt my head
I hop from the grass onto a stone
My tail feathers bob lightly
I flutter half a block up and drop back

lines.zh: 我一跃就到了下一根枝
lines.en: One hop carries me to the next branch
I peck my way along the ground
I crouch on the branch without moving
One flick and I face another way
Insects crawl under the grass
I fluff my feathers for warmth
I tuck in without moving a wing
I am watching the trees far off
My claws grip the branch
I am a small quiet bundle
I bury my face in my feathers
I wait for this gust to pass
Are you new here
I am used to people in this forest
You are so close I cannot see you
Don't stare at me like that

lines.zh: 你的影子把我的光挡住了
lines.en: Your shadow is blocking my light
I will fly off at once
You do not have a net, do you

lines.zh: 我的羽毛比你想象的硬
lines.en: My feathers are harder than you think
I am not afraid of you, but I will hide
One more step and I fly
Red down from my breast falls away
The blow knocks me half a foot wide
I shriek and fly up

lines.zh: 这点伤对六点生命很重
lines.en: This is heavy for six health
My wings beat raggedly
I drop low to hide
I run a few steps in the grass
I shrink into a tuft of red
I shake out all my feathers
I have not flown far
Are those seeds in your hand
There is something in your palm
I am watching from the branch
I like this very much
Crouch down and I will dare approach
Keep your palm flat and still
I will hop a little closer first
I do not know this color
It smells edible
I peck once and retreat
You touched my feathers
I flutter away

lines.zh: 我们撞了一下，我掉了几根毛
lines.en: We bumped and I lost a few feathers

lines.zh: 你的指头比我整只鸟还大
lines.en: Your finger is bigger than my whole body
I skim past your fingers and rise
That bump annoyed me
I settle on a higher branch
I shake myself all over
I will not hold it against you
I keep my distance
It is not that season yet
A few songs are enough for us

lines.zh: 我在这一片有自己的位置
lines.en: I have my own place in this patch
You asked too directly
My call carries far
I cock my head for one glance
I turn back to preening
I will not answer a word
I hop off elsewhere
I pay that no mind at all
One peck and the seed is mine
This one is just right
I flit up to the branch with it
There is always something to pick up on the ground

lines.zh: 爪子翻开落叶，找到吃的
lines.en: My claws turn the leaf litter for a meal
This one is too hard
I tuck it into a crack in the bark
I keep this to eat slowly
I look up to see if there is more
I flutter away
Something rustles past the grass
I lift my head and stare
That shadow is not a tree's
All my feathers have risen
I give two short calls
I am about to take off

lines.zh: 那东西进了我的两格内
lines.en: That thing is inside my two blocks
I need another position
I retreat to a higher branch
I hold still on the branch
Something has come near my tree
I give two warning calls first
My crest stands straight up
I plan to startle it first

lines.zh: 这个东西比虫子大得多
lines.en: This thing is far bigger than a bug
I am on the branch above it
I am set to dive

lines.zh: 我的爪子先在枝上磨了磨
lines.en: I sharpen my claws on the branch first
I keep watching from the branch
It walked past and turned back
I flatten myself low
My calls grow sharper
I hop to a farther branch
I can see it if it looks up
I switch branches and call again
I hold my wings half spread
Move on, and I'll come down
Two more calls will do
I wheel above its head
It moves, and I call
I wait for it to turn its back
I keep hopping to new positions
My calls have changed pitch
Only two blocks away
I count each step it takes
It turned its face this way
I flatten, wingtips down
This grove goes by my word
I dive and peck
That only knocked out a few feathers
I beat its head with my wings
My claw rakes across its hand
I peck and fly off
I peck once and pull away
I sweep past from behind
My call is loud
I settle on a high branch
I dive from above
My beak pecks its hand
I beat its eyes with my wings

lines.zh: 我的爪子抓了一下它的耳朵
lines.en: My claws rake its ear
This is only enough to make it pull back
My feathers are all puffed out
I bump it with my body
This is the last strike
One strike and I am behind the tree

lines.zh: 我的爪子钩住它的衣角
lines.en: My claws hook its hem
This is where I leave
I drop from the treetop

lines.zh: 这片森林到处是我的声音
lines.en: My voice is all over this forest
I am red as a flame
I shake the dust off my wing
A pair of my kind are calling here
I found a good branch
I open my throat and sing
I brought a pair this trip
My home is in the canopy

lines.zh: 我从这棵树看到那棵树
lines.en: I look from this tree to the next
I hop out of the leaves
I'm calling before I even land

lines.zh: 火燎到我的羽毛，一片焦味
lines.en: Fire caught my feathers, a burnt smell
My grip slips and I drop off the branch
Water soaked me through

lines.zh: 爆炸的浪把我掀进树丛
lines.en: The blast throws me into the thicket

lines.zh: 箭羽刮掉了我几根红羽
lines.en: Fletching strips a few red feathers

lines.zh: 那股术力让我的羽毛竖起
lines.en: That magic made my feathers stand up
I have not found seeds yet
The flash turned the whole tree white
There are no branches and no ground
